-                           D E S C R I P T I O N                              -

This txt file contains flight IDs where at least one detected airborne object
has a bounding box area of 36 px² or less at some point during the sequence.
Used to evaluate model performance specifically on the smallest and hardest to
detect targets, isolating whether object size is a primary contributing factor
to missed detections.
